We built their product team and helped them attract investment.

When RUUF came to us, they had a strong product thesis and a founding team that understood the market. What they did not have was an engineering team. No CTO, no developers, no architecture. They needed to go from idea to working product fast enough to validate the model with real users and close a funding round.

Hiring a full senior engineering team from scratch takes months. RUUF did not have months. They needed a team that could start immediately, own the architecture decisions, and ship a production-grade product without the overhead of building an internal team first.
We became RUUF's product and engineering team end to end.

Bank integrations were a core part of the build. Payment processing, installment tracking, and financial compliance in a regulated environment require backend architecture that is built correctly from day one. We owned those decisions.

The frontend, mobile, backend, and infrastructure were all built and maintained by our team. Architecture decisions, sprint planning, deployment pipelines, and production monitoring included. RUUF's founding team focused on the business while we focused on the product.
The platform moved from idea to production on a timeline that let RUUF run real go-to-market work and close their funding round.

RUUF launched a production-grade rent-to-own platform and successfully closed a funding round with a working product in market. The platform handled real users, real properties, and real financial transactions.

We offer no-money-down installations that generate free money for homeowners from day one. We are digitalizing the whole process of going solar. Instead of using traditional forms and leaving it up to customers to fill them, we use technology to take all that burden off our customers plate. We only ask for an address and offer free instant quotes.
Ruuf digitizes the entire solar adoption process, requiring only an address and electricity usage to generate instant quotes and financing options, reducing customer friction dramatically[1][3].
Connects homeowners with vetted local installers and lenders, ensuring competitive pricing and quality service while streamlining coordination[4][8].
Operates in Chile, a leader in renewable energy policy with laws incentivizing residential solar adoption, which enhances Ruuf’s value proposition[1].
